investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Lumora Learning (online courses); Platform: on-premises VM fleet and PostgreSQL cluster, server range 172.18.0.0/16; Database: learners-db (primary learners-db-01, replica learners-db-02); Automation: data-retention and housekeeping DAGs scheduled by Apache Airflow and executed under service accounts (DAG runs recorded with RUN- identifiers); Change management: CHG- identifiers.
